name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist and inventor of Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD).

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland and author of the source essay.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola was born.

name: Finland
summary: Country where Tuomo Suntola lived and worked.

name: Turku
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola went to school.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University in Finland where Tuomo Suntola studied electrical engineering.

name: VTT Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Laboratory established in 1964 as part of Professor Thor Stubb's Electron Physics laboratory in HUT.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at HUT who supervised Tuomo Suntola's doctoral thesis.

name: Vaisala Oy
summary: Finnish company specializing in meteorological instrumentation.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague of Tuomo Suntola who worked on the Humicap sensor and ALE development.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Company that imported medical instrumentation and later established a technology company Datex Oy.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Building material company that acquired the ALE-EL project from Instrumentarium.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Closest co-worker to Tuomo Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague involved in the ALE-EL development and chloride process demonstration.

name: Planar Inc.
summary: American competitor that acquired Lohja's EL business in 1990.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in Olarinluoma in 2012.

name: Elcoteq Oy
summary: Independent company separated from Lohja's microelectronics division in 1990.

name: Antti Piippo
summary: Business-oriented manager invited to Lohja from Aspo Oy.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that established Neste Advanced Power Systems (NAPS).

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Subsidiary of Neste established for the development of ALE-based solar panels and reactors.

name: Matti Ervasti
summary: Business-oriented managing director invited to take care of Microchemistry.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that acquired Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company set up by Sven Lindfors and Kustaa Poutiainen in 2004.

name: Kustaa Poutiainen
summary: Co-founder of Picosun Oy with Sven Lindfors.

name: Jun-ichi Nishizawa
summary: Professor from Japan who realized the significance of ALE and started MLE research.

name: Lauri Niinistö
summary: Professor of inorganic and analytical chemistry at HUT who organized the first ALE conference.

name: Aleskovskii
summary: Professor in the Soviet Union who initiated the molecular layering technique.

name: Victor Drozd
summary: Researcher who invited Suntola to visit the University of Leningrad.

name: Ahti Aintila
summary: Colleague who created knowhow in driving circuitries for EL panels.

name: Espoo
summary: City in Finland where Instrumentarium and Lohja facilities were located.

name: Lohja
summary: City in Finland where Lohja Oy had a plant.

name: San Diego
summary: City in California where the SID conference was held.

name: Boston
summary: City where the MRS 1994 Annual Meeting was held.

name: Leningrad
summary: City where Suntola visited Aleskovskii in 1990.

name: Munich
summary: City where the European SEMI Award was handed to Suntola.

name: Humicap 1
summary: Humidity sensor based on the original patent by Suntola.

name: ALE Patent 1974
summary: International patent on ALE as a method for the growth of compound thin films.

name: ALE Patent 1979
summary: Second international ALE patent covering inert gas reactor and basic processes.

name: F-120 reactor
summary: Quick, compact research reactor designed for photovoltaic development.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring the Pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition Techniques.

name: The Dynamic Universe
summary: Book published by Suntola in 2011 on a holistic picture of reality.
